sourceObjectiveSpecificRationale: The complete D020 source confirms the same folding-table collection scenario: checking for damaged legs, reporting damage to the desk, photographs for damage assessment, and verifying folded-table dimensions against vehicle access and capacity. This is substantive scenario reuse, not merely a repeated readability objective.
